confirmation_sample.definition: matches whose PLAY timestamp (matches.match_time_stamp) is strictly greater than the snapshot's maximum play time, passing the identical filters (12 players, 6 per side, no is_win=2, scores present, every player with positive play time, duration >= 240 s), and inside the same balance regime
confirmation_sample.not_confirmation: matches downloaded after the freeze but played on or before 2026-09-08T11:00:32Z (historical backfill)
confirmation_sample.regime_rule: if an official patch that changes hero, team-up or map mechanics is released inside the window, the window ends at that patch's release time and matches played after it are excluded; the patch audit (results/patch_audit.md) records the regime boundaries
confirmation_sample.stopping_rule: evaluate once, at the earlier of (a) 40,000 eligible confirmation matches or (b) 2026-09-30T23:59:59Z harvest stop; if fewer than 10,000 eligible matches (amended, see amendments) report INCONCLUSIVE (insufficient sample)
confirmation_sample.isolation: confirmation matches are excluded from every design build, tuning fold, diagnostic plot, interaction selection and report decision by filtering on play time <= 1788865232; nothing in results/lineup_* reads matches beyond that bound before the lock

lock: the candidate specification, penalties, feature definitions and fitted coefficients are hashed into results/lineup_lock.json BEFORE any confirmation outcome is read; the baseline is the headline fit W0_specAplus (model fit 31cfdff) as published, refitted on the frozen development sample only if the patch audit removes more than 5% of it

promotion_criterion.primary: paired per-match log-loss improvement D = mean(loss_baseline - loss_candidate) over eligible confirmation matches, with both models predicting from pre-match information only
promotion_criterion.uncertainty: two 95% intervals for D: (i) paired i.i.d. over matches, (ii) player-multiplicity bootstrap over the confirmation matches' players (1,000 draws); PROMOTE requires interval (ii) to exclude zero with D > 0
promotion_criterion.calibration: candidate calibration slope in [0.85, 1.15] and |intercept| <= 0.05 on the log-odds scale, overall and within each supported rank third (dev-sample boundaries 4,443 and 4,649 on mean lobby score)
promotion_criterion.subgroups: no supported rank third with D < -0.001
promotion_criterion.outcomes: PROMOTE if all conditions hold; RETAIN headline if interval (ii) is entirely below zero or calibration fails; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise, including insufficient sample
promotion_criterion.after_failure: any revised candidate needs a new confirmation window

amendments.change: minimum eligible sample lowered from 20,000 to 10,000
amendments.reason: the patch audit (external fact, results/patch_audit.md) shows the Season 9.5 regime ends 2026-09-11T09:00Z, bounding the window to ~70 hours of play; a power calculation on development-fold per-match loss differences (sd ~0.05-0.10) gives SE(D) ~0.0007 at 10,000 matches, sufficient for the gains that would justify promotion (D >= 0.002); the 40,000 target and the 2026-09-30 harvest stop are unchanged
eligible confirmation matches are those played after 2026-09-08T11:00:32Z and before 2026-09-11T09:00:00Z (Season 10 patch)

amendments.change: collection stopped at the user's instruction (crawler paused with 39 matches played after the snapshot); the confirmation sample is redefined as an INTERNAL slice of the frozen snapshot
amendments.definition: eligible confirmation matches = snapshot matches with play time > 1788519632 (2026-09-04T11:00:32Z, the final four days of play), passing the legal-lineup filter; development = snapshot matches with play time <= 1788519632; every design build, fold, tuning run, diagnostic and report decision of the rebuild uses development rows only
amendments.baseline: the published headline fit was estimated on the whole snapshot, so for a like-for-like comparison the baseline (Spec A+, identical specification) is REFITTED on the development rows; the published coefficients are not used in the confirmation
amendments.caveat: the final week of the snapshot informed the published report's holdout figures and the decision not to adopt unpenalized pair blocks; the rebuild's tuning and selection never read the slice, but it is not a post-lock future sample
amendments.stopping_rule: evaluate once, after the candidate is locked; sample size is fixed by the definition

amendments.change: legal-lineup filter added to both samples
amendments.reason: 1.36% of snapshot matches (6,475) have two teammates whose first-appearance hero is the same, which cannot be a simultaneous start; their starting record is unverifiable and they are excluded, not collapsed
